notes.text: Matched displayed institution-scoped accession VI 13229 and the complete 7,5 x 11,5 x 5,6 cm dimensions with the IndiGen entry; type and provenance were also compared. IndiGen classifies this object as Ika; the museum calls it tahonga / Brustschmuck. The exact accession, dimensions and collector support identity while the disagreement remains attributed. Selective transcription of the displayed catalogue fields; participant roles and acquisition wording remain contextual descriptions, and geographical associations are not treated as making-place claims. The chosen photograph was checked visually against the catalogue and carries an explicit image-specific CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 credit.
